abstract_sentences.text: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)-extension refers to modifying or generalizing the Rotary Position Embedding scheme to handle longer sequences than those encountered during pre-training.
abstract_sentences.relation: opens the abstract by defining the target scope

abstract_sentences.text: However, current extension strategies are highly diverse and lack a unified theoretical foundation.
abstract_sentences.relation: contrasts the definition with the theory gap

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we propose MrRoPE (Mixed-radix RoPE), a generalized encoding formulation based on a radix system conversion perspective, which elegantly unifies various RoPE-extension approaches as distinct radix conversion strategies.
abstract_sentences.relation: answers the gap with the unified encoding formulation

abstract_sentences.text: Based on this theory, we introduce two training-free extensions, MrRoPE-Uni and MrRoPE-Pro, which leverage uniform and progressive radix conversion strategies, respectively, to achieve “train short, test long” generalization.
abstract_sentences.relation: instantiates the preceding theory as two methods

abstract_sentences.text: Without fine-tuning, MrRoPE-Pro sustains over 85% recall in the 128K-context Needle-in-a-Haystack test and achieves more than double YaRN’s accuracy on Infinite-Bench retrieval and dialogue subsets.
abstract_sentences.comparison: YaRN on retrieval and dialogue subsets

abstract_sentences.text: Theoretical analysis confirms that MrRoPE-Pro effectively raises the upper bound of RoPE’s attainable encoding length, which further validates the reliability and utility of our theory and methodology.
abstract_sentences.relation: closes the abstract by linking theory to methodological utility

method_moves.description: Incomplete-cycle dimensions are reframed as high-digit truncation.
Eq. (9) rescales radix bases and Eq. (10) applies the analogous mixed-radix angle.
The vector λ assigns conversion factors and defines the unifying parameterization.
Eq. (11) and Eq. (12) recover NTK-aware interpolation and YaRN as constrained instances.
The manuscript asks whether YaRN’s regressive middle-dimension conversion is optimal.
MrRoPE-Uni uses a constant intermediate λ in Eq. (13).
MrRoPE-Pro makes εj arithmetic and λj progressive in Eq. (14).
Eq. (15) restates the general modified rotation angle.
Eq. (16) makes λ piecewise over low, middle, and high dimensions.
Figure 3 visualizes cumulative scaling and frames YaRN as MrRoPE-Regressive for comparison.

theory_analysis.name: Biased β-radix interpretation
theory_analysis.description: Eq. (4)–(7) aligns RoPE angles and a reconstructed m̂ with radix digits; Figure 2 supplies a linearity visualization. This is an explanatory derivation, not a named theorem.
theory_analysis.assumptions: β=b^(1/Dr); the prose first temporarily ignores floor and modulo-period effects, then reintroduces them.
theory_analysis.conclusion: RoPE is presented as a biased β-radix encoding.

theory_analysis.name: MrRoPE unifying formulation
theory_analysis.description: Eq. (10) makes λ dimension-specific; Eq. (11) and Eq. (12) instantiate NTK and YaRN. PI is later stated not to be expressible in Eq. (16) form.
theory_analysis.conclusion: Such extensions are mixed-radix conversion policies.

theory_analysis.name: YaRN regression
theory_analysis.description: Appendix A.2.1 derives the inequality for neighboring λ factors and declares the conversion regressive.
theory_analysis.assumptions: b≠1 and the YaRN middle-dimension formula.
theory_analysis.conclusion: λj−1>λj for the stated rope-theta conditions.

theory_analysis.name: RoPE Bound Theory diagnostic
theory_analysis.description: The paper computes the root of Bθ(m)=Σ cos(mθj) for several methods and reports 1K, 6K, and 28K values.
theory_analysis.assumptions: The cited RoPE Bound Theory root is a suitable upper-bound proxy.
theory_analysis.conclusion: MrRoPE-Pro has the larger reported proxy bound at base 10,000.

final_judgment.single_storyline: MrRoPE recasts incomplete RoPE rotation cycles as mixed-radix allocation, then argues that a progressive middle-dimension λ schedule preserves high-frequency detail while enlarging the position-encoding range.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: The main text keeps the λ framework, Uni/Pro equations, strategy visualization, main PPL table, stress and benchmark tables, and the bound/attention diagnostics.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: The appendix holds the YaRN regression derivation, implementation boundaries, hyperparameter scans, LLaMA2 PPL, LongBench-V2, LLM-use disclosure, and explicit limitations.
final_judgment.best_pattern: A shared visual and symbolic object, λ, recurs from Figure 1 through Eq. (10) and Eq. (13)–(16) to Figure 3, then is tested with tables and diagnostics.
final_judgment.largest_gap: The unification claim has a PI scope exception, the bound and attention diagnostics do not formally bridge to task outcomes, and two printed table/prose labels are internally inconsistent.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For a new parameterization, align one mechanism visual, a concise definition, an auditable nearest-baseline derivation, and matched-condition empirical tests around the same object.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: This pattern fits work whose key difference can be concentrated in one shared parameter object; it is insufficient when data, architecture, optimization, and protocol change together.
